description: CPD-8: a binding secret version's digest (`secret.versionDigest`, the pin's `binding.versionDigest`) is the canonical digest of {binding, version}, so a pin names one version of one binding and every later version of the same binding is checkable from the pin alone. Read by Node (control-plane/domain/bindings.ts bindingVersionDigestInput, binding-vault.test.ts VB-3) and Python (app.control_plane.runtime.bindings.binding_version_digest, tests/unit/harness/credentials/test_binding_source.py).
